description: Lists the events of one sport with their ids, for event_odds. Serves every region, one region code a call. Costs no tokens. Paged: pass next_cursor back as cursor.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous reply, with the same other arguments

limit.description: Most events to return; a note counts the rest

region.description: One region code from the regions tool, such as uk or us. Left out, the API uses uk, or refuses with region_required and names the code to send.

sport.description: Which sport: tennis, or a competition key from the sports tool

name: events
title: Events
